categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Has the P2P label and modifies connection management logic in src/net.cpp and src/net.h.
categories.rationale: Prevents redundant connection attempts from establishing duplicate manual connections during startup races. The PR tracks in-flight manual connection targets in CConnman to address a race condition between concurrent manual connection mechanisms like -connect and -addnode.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: The only test edit is a p2p-specific functional test registered in test_runner.py, which belongs to p2p rather than test infrastructure.
categories.rationale: Test framework changes are limited to registering a specific functional test for p2p connection behavior.
